Class Animal

java.lang.Object
com.trashslammers.model.Animal
public class Animal extends Object
An animal the shop sells. Whether the player owns one, and where they put it, is tracked separately by OwnedAnimal.

  • Constructor Details

    • Animal

      public Animal(String id, String name, String species, Rarity rarity, int cost, int basePointsPerSecond, String spriteFile, String habitat, String fact)
      Constructs a new Animal with the specified details.
      Parameters:
      id - The id of the animal, used for ownership lookups and never shown to the player
      name - The name of the animal
      species - The species of the animal
      rarity - The rarity of the animal
      cost - The cost of the animal in points
      spriteFile - The file name of the animal's sprite, or null if it doesn't have one
      habitat - The habitat of the animal
      fact - A fact about the animal, revealed when it is unlocked
